o.en:
A custom workflow for Flux and flux dev. This is for more advanced users, but not over the top or anything, just a bit more than the plain flow.

`

Features:

  • Advanced LLM Prompting with plush nodes

  • Fully gguf ready

  • Lora loader ready

  • Hires and tiled ksampler

  • Inpainting

  • IMG2IMG

  • TXT2IMG

  • Civit metadata saver

  • 1st pass deblur

  • 2k and 4k compatible (before upscales).

  • 2x hires upscale

  • 4x model upscale

  • custom image sharpening

`

Model needed for this workflow:

-4x dat2https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-RealWebPhoto-v4-dat2

-Fatality Deblur:https://github.com/marduk191/nmkd-mirror/blob/main/ESRGAN/Models/Misc%201x%20Models/1x_Fatality_DeBlur_270000_G.pth

-T5 text encoder:https://huggingface.co/city96/t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-gguf/tree/main

-Flux dev gguf:https://huggingface.co/city96/FLUX.1-dev-gguf

-Flux dev VAE:https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev/blob/main/ae.safetensors

`

Other requirements:

cpu offload nodes:https://gist.github.com/city96/30743dfdfe129b331b5676a79c3a8a39#file-comfybootlegoffload-py
